tool.name: Biomni: Generate Embeddings With State
tool.description: Generate State embeddings for single-cell RNA-seq data using the SE-600M model.
tool.command:
python -c " import sys import json from biomni.tool.genomics import generate_embeddings_with_state
# Parse arguments args = {} i = 1 while i < len(sys.argv): if sys.argv[i].startswith('--'): key = sys.argv[i][2:] if i + 1 < len(sys.argv) and not sys.argv[i + 1].startswith('--'): val = sys.argv[i + 1] # Type conversion if val.lower() == 'true': val = True elif val.lower() == 'false': val = False else: try: val = int(val) except: try: val = float(val) except: pass args[key] = val i += 2 else: args[key] = True i += 1 else: i += 1
# Call function result = generate_embeddings_with_state(**args)
# Write output output_path = args.get('output', '/dev/stdout') with open(output_path, 'w') as f: if isinstance(result, str): f.write(result) elif isinstance(result, (dict, list)): json.dump(result, f, indent=2, default=str) else: f.write(str(result)) " --output '$output' --adata_filename '$adata_filename' --data_dir '$data_dir' --model_folder '$model_folder' #if $output_filename --output_filename '$output_filename' #end if #if $checkpoint --checkpoint '$checkpoint' #end if #if $embed_key --embed_key '$embed_key' #end if #if $protein_embeddings --protein_embeddings '$protein_embeddings' #end if #if $batch_size --batch_size '$batch_size' #end if

param.name: adata_filename
param.label: Adata Filename
param.help: Name of the input AnnData file (.h5ad format)

param.name: data_dir
param.label: Data Dir
param.help: Directory containing the input data file

param.name: model_folder
param.label: Model Folder

param.label: Output Filename

param.label: Checkpoint

tool.help:
**Biomni: Generate Embeddings With State**
Generate State embeddings for single-cell RNA-seq data using the SE-600M model.
This function downloads the SE-600M model from Hugging Face, installs required dependencies, and generates embeddings for the input AnnData object.
Parameters: ----------- adata_filename : str Name of the input AnnData file (.h5ad format) data_dir : str Directory containing the input data file model_folder : str Directory where the SE-600M model will be downloaded and stored output_filename : str, optional Name of the output file. If None, will use input filename with '_state_embeddings' suffix checkpoint : str, optional Path to the specific model checkpoint. If None, uses the latest checkpoint in model_folder embed_key : str, default="X_state" Name of key to store embeddings in the output AnnData object protein_embeddings : str, optional Path to protein embeddings override (.pt). If omitted, auto-detects in model folder batch_size : int, default=500 Batch size for embedding forward pass. Increase to use more VRAM and speed up embedding
Returns: -------- str Research log summarizing the steps performed and results
Notes: ------ - Requires 10GB+ GPU memory for model loading - Downloads ~25GB model files from Hugging Face - Installs git-lfs, uv, and arc-state if not already available - Validates input h5ad file format (CSR matrix and gene_name column) - Provides real-time streaming output for git clone and embedding generation - Includes automatic retry with reduced batch size on failure
**Domain**: genomics **Function**: generate_embeddings_with_state
